verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI supports non-interactive scripted runs, GitHub Actions triggers (PR review, issue triage), and structured JSON output, which can be wired into external cron/CI schedulers to approximate recurring workflows, but there is no native scheduler, cron-like syntax, or built-in recurring job feature documented. missing for 10: a first-party scheduling/cron mechanism, persistent recurring job management UI or config, independent confirmation of scheduled automation working reliably.
